# Know Your Meme

> > A comprehensive database documenting internet memes, viral trends, and digital culture phenomena across platforms like TikTok, Twitter, YouTube, and beyond.

Know Your Meme serves as the definitive encyclopedia for understanding the origins, evolution, and cultural impact of internet memes. The site features detailed entries on exploitable memes, viral videos, catchphrases, and social media trends, along with editorial guides explaining complex or rapidly-evolving meme phenomena.

## Key Topics

- TikTok trends and viral videos
- Exploitable memes and image macros
- Twitter/X viral content
- Catchphrases and song-based memes
- Dance trends and challenges
- Nostalgia memes
- YouTube culture
- DeviantArt and fan art
- Breaking Bad references
- 90s hood movie culture
- Cat memes
- Accuracy reenactments
- Meme explanations and context

## Viral Meme Entries

- [Jesse, What the Fuck Are You Talking About](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/jesse-what-the-fuck-are-you-talking-about): Breaking Bad dialogue meme with Walter White and Jesse Pinkman
- [We Still Talk About You](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/we-still-talk-about-you): Exploitable meme featuring cat art, viral on TikTok and Twitter
- [I'm Talking About Innit](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/im-talking-about-innit): TikTok dance trend based on BunnaB & YKNiece's 'Innit' song catchphrase

## Meme Explainers and Guides

- [What Do The Memes About Hearing Saxophones In The Hood Mean?](https://trending.knowyourmeme.com/editorials/guides/what-do-the-memes-about-hearing-saxophones-in-the-hood-mean-the-viral-90s-hood-movie-trend-explained): Explainer on Boyz n the Hood saxophone meme trend on TikTok/Instagram
- [Who Is The 'Bananas And Rice' Girl?](https://trending.knowyourmeme.com/editorials/guides/who-is-the-bananas-and-rice-girl-the-viral-memes-about-somali-american-ice-victim-nasra-ahmed-explained): Guide explaining viral Nasra Ahmed ICE incident and 'Bananas and Rice' meme
